notes.title: Update 1.1 - Save System And Achievements
notes.content:
Hi everyone, [b]Dymchick1[/b] is here! 

I'm happy to announce:

[h2]FIRST BIG GAME UPDATE[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Save system [/b]
You can save your game progress. This is a new feature so the bugs are possible. Tell us your experience! 
[*][b]Achievements[/b]
They are finally fixed. We plan to add more achievements in the future. 
[*][b]A lot of bug fixes [/b]
Thanks to all users who sent us found bugs! If you find more then go to our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/Jv5pdrK]https://discord.gg/Jv5pdrK[/url] and ping me [b](Dymchick1)[/b] or [b]Oxy949[/b]. 
[/list]

Have a nice day!

tags.feature: You can save your game progress.
